MeInsert bundles ExifTool 13.60 (Perl script + Image::ExifTool library,
minified) inside @colorhythm/exiftool-wasm v1.0.5, which executes it in
WebAssembly via zeroperl. The notice above is reproduced here per the
licence condition to retain copyright notices. The upstream project
distributes the full license text and test suite with the official
tarball; the operative statement is the one quoted above.
